blurb.plain: Innate: Kled rides his semi-trusty steed, Skaarl, whom takes damage for him while he is Mounted. When Skaarl health depletes, Kled dismounts, cleansing from all crowd control.

blurb2.plain: Kled remains Dismounted until he returns to the summoning platform, but can restore Skaarl Courage by fighting enemies. At maximum Courage, Kled becomes Mounted with a portion of Skaarl health.

blurb4.plain: Dismounted: Kled gains bonus movement speed while moving toward enemy champions, but his basic attacks deal less damage to champions. Bear Trap on a Rope is replaced with Pocket Pistol, and Kled cannot cast his other abilities.

description.plain: Innate: Kled rides his semi-trusty mount, Skaarl. While Mounted, all damage dealt to the duo is suffered by Skaarl, who has ⟦pplevel⟧ base health; additional sources of health are applied to Skaarl maximum health. Effects based on percentage health consider Kled and Skaarl combined maximum health.

description2.plain: Being reduced below 0 health causes Skaarl to flee, forcing Kled to be Dismounted, with all damage in excess of Skaarl health being ignored. Upon dismounting, Kled lunges in the direction of the allied Nexus, though not through terrain, while cleansing himself of all crowd control and becoming unable to act, untargetable, and immune to crowd control for 0.5 seconds. Dismounting resets the cooldown and charges of Pocket Pistol.

description3.plain: While Kled is Dismounted, his base health and movement speed are reduced; however, he gains bonus movement speed while moving toward enemy champions. Additionally, he gains bonus attack range, and his attacks deal 85% – 100% (based on level) damage to champions. Bear Trap on a Rope is replaced with Pocket Pistol, while Jousting and Chaaaaaaaarge!!! become unusable.

description4.plain: While Mounted, healing and health regeneration will first replenish Skaarl health and will only apply to Kled's health while Skaarl is at full health.

description5.plain: For more details, check the Dismounted part of the ability.

params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Kled''' is only vulnerable to {{tip|death}} while {{sbc|Dismounted}}. '''Kled''' has {{sti|health|{{as|{{pplevel|{{ccd|Kled|hp_base}}+{{ccd|Kled|hp_lvl}}*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1))}} '''base''' health}}}}, which is not improved by sources of {{as|'''bonus''' health}}, his {{as|movement speed}} is reduced{{ft|by {{as|{{#expr:{{ccd|Kled & Skaarl|ms}}-{{ccd|Kled|ms}}}}|movement speed}}|to {{as|{{ccd|Kled|ms}}|movement speed}}}}, and he gains {{sti|attack range|{{#expr:{{ccd|Kled|range}}-{{ccd|Kled & Skaarl|range}}}} '''total'''<!--not base, but possibly not bonus either because it doesn't affect acquisition range--> attack range}}. Effects based on percentage health consider '''Kled''' and '''{{uis|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' combined {{as|'''maximum''' health}}, meaning that a {{sbc|Dismounted}} '''Kled''' is never considered to be at ''full'' health.
params.description2: '''Kled''' gains {{pplevel|70 to 155|color=ms}} {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while facing and {{tt|after attacking|see notes}} nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy {{tip|champions}}, but his {{tip|basic attack|basic attacks}} against them are reduced to {{as|{{pp|85 to 100 for 4|1;6;11;16|key=%}} AD}} {{as|physical damage}}. He also gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}} equal to 4 {{as|(+ 1% of '''bonus''' health)}}, increased by 30% for each nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy champion, up to a maximum of {{ap|4*2.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|1*2.5}}% '''bonus''' health)}} resistances. Additionally, he gains the ability to restore '''{{uis|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' {{as|Courage|buzzword}} to ''{{ai|Skaarl the Cowardly Lizard|Kled|mount}}'' again.
params.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Courage:}} '''Kled''' gains 15 {{as|Courage|buzzword}} after completing a basic attack against a champion and 5 {{as|Courage|buzzword}} for lane {{tip|minion}} kills and when basic attacking {{tip|structures}} or epic {{tip|monsters}}. He can also restore {{as|Courage|buzzword}} from hitting enemies with ''{{ai|Pocket Pistol|Kled}}''. Upon reaching 100 {{as|Courage|buzzword}}, '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' instantly restores {{as|{{pp|key=%|40 to 70 for 4|1 to 16}} of her '''maximum''' health}} and reunites with '''Kled''' over {{fd|0.25}} seconds, after which he consumes all {{as|Courage|buzzword}} to become {{sbc|Mounted}} and the duo become {{tip|lockout|unable}} to declare basic attacks or cast their {{tip|abilities}} for {{fd|0.25}} seconds. ''Mounting up'' resets the {{sti|cooldowns}} of ''{{ai|Bear Trap on a Rope|Kled}}'' and ''{{ai|Jousting|Kled}}''.
params.description4: While at the allied [[Spawn|fountain]], 25 {{as|Courage|buzzword}} is generated every {{fd|0.25}} seconds. If reuniting outside of the fountain, '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' gets ''Frayed Nerves'', which prevents '''Kled''' from gaining {{as|Courage|buzzword}} for 30 seconds. Being within the fountain while {{sbc|Dismounted}} removes ''Frayed Nerves''.
params.description5: ''The current status of '''Kled's''' own health is preserved between subsequent dismounts.''
params.effect radius: {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|1200|Enemy champion radius check for granting the movement speed}} / {{tip|cr|icononly=true}} {{tt|1400|Enemy champion radius check for granting the resistances}}
params.notes: * {{tip|Clone|Clones}} are considered to be champions for all of this ability's effects. * {{ui|Voidmite|Voidmites}}, and {{cis|Bel'Veth}} [[File:Bel'Veth Death in Lavender.png|20px|border]] [[Bel'Veth#Pets|Void Remora]] are '''not''' considered to be lane {{tip|minions}} for the purpose of {{as|courage|buzzword}} generation. * The {{as|movement speed}} reduction will apply to '''Kled's''' '''bonus''' movement speed. ** If his '''bonus''' movement speed would be reduced below 0, his '''base''' movement speed is reduced instead equal to the remaining reduction, or by the full amount if he has no '''bonus''' movement speed. * '''Kled''' will retain the {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} buff for {{fd|1.5}} seconds while facing an enemy champion even if that champion is no longer {{tip|sight|visible}}. * After completing a {{tip|basic attack}} against a champion, the {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} buff is granted for {{fd|1.5}} seconds regardless of his facing direction. * The {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} buff's value is refreshed when '''Kled''' levels up. * '''Kled''' will neither gain {{as|Courage|buzzword}} nor {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} if his basic attack is {{tip|dodge|dodged}}, {{tip|block|blocked}}, {{tip|blind|missed}} or {{ai|Riposte|Fiora|parried}}. * It is possible to get the {{as|Courage|buzzword}} from the fountain but have '''Kled''' and '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' reunite outside the fountain. * Sources of increased {{as|'''maximum''' health}} that additionally restore {{as|'''current''' health}} will restore '''Kled's''' {{as|'''current''' health}} even if he is '''DISMOUNTED'''. * The {{as|Courage|buzzword}} bar is '''white''' when under 50 courage, '''yellow''' when equal to or above 50 courage, and '''red''' at 100 courage. * If '''Kled''' enters {{tip|stasis}} during the first {{fd|0.25}} seconds of reuniting with '''Skaarl''', the remount will be deferred by another {{fd|0.25}} seconds. ** This is a remnant of the pre-[[V25.14]] behavior, when entering {{tip|stasis}} or {{tip|resurrection}} during the first {{fd|0.25}} of the remount sequence would deffer the remount until the end of those effects.
params.tips:
* During the first {{fd|0.25}} seconds of remounting, '''Kled''' can finish an {{tip|basic attack|attack}}, cast {{ai|Pocket Pistol|Kled}}, and utilize the {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} toward champions.<!--that's because he's still dismounted by this point, which is implied by the wording but some people may not get that-->
<!-- Blurb -->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} While {{sbc|Dismounted}}, '''{{ci|Kled}}''' suffers all damage taken and is vulnerable to {{tip|death}}. '''Kled's''' {{as|base health}} cannot be improved through any means, his {{as|movement speed}} is reduced, and his {{tip|basic attack|basic attacks}} against {{tip|champions}} deal less {{as|physical damage}}. However, '''Kled''' gains a large amount of {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} when facing {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy champions, {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}}, and he has the ability to restore '''{{uis|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' {{ai|Skaarl the Cowardly Lizard 3|Kled|{{as|Courage|buzzword}}}} to ''{{ai|Skaarl the Cowardly Lizard|Kled|mount}}'' again.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Courage:}} Kled gains a large amount of {{as|Courage|buzzword}} by {{tip|basic attack|basic attacking}} champions and a small amount when killing {{tip|minion|minions}}, or attacking [[structures]] or epic {{tip|monster|monsters}}. At 100 {{as|Courage|buzzword}}, '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' returns and '''Kled''' becomes {{sbc|Mounted}}. '''Kled's''' own {{as|health}} is preserved through re-mounting.
params.blurb3:
Entering the [[Spawn|fountain]] will always restore {{as|Courage|buzzword}} and return '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}'''. Outside of the fountain, '''Kled''' cannot gain {{as|Courage|buzzword}} for 30 seconds after re-mounting.

description.plain: Innate: Kled is only vulnerable to death while Dismounted. Kled has ⟦pplevel⟧ base health, which is not improved by sources of bonus health, his movement speed is reducedby ⟦#expr:ccd-ccd⟧, and he gains ⟦#expr:ccd-ccd⟧ total attack range. Effects based on percentage health consider Kled and Skaarl combined maximum health, meaning that a Dismounted Kled is never considered to be at full health.

description2.plain: Kled gains 70 – 155 (based on level) bonus movement speed while facing and after attacking nearby visible enemy champions, but his basic attacks against them are reduced to 85% – 100% (based on level) AD physical damage. He also gains bonus armor and bonus magic resistance equal to 4 (+ 1% of bonus health), increased by 30% for each nearby visible enemy champion, up to a maximum of 10 (+ 2.5% bonus health) resistances. Additionally, he gains the ability to restore Skaarl Courage to mount again.

description3.plain: Innate - Courage: Kled gains 15 Courage after completing a basic attack against a champion and 5 Courage for lane minion kills and when basic attacking structures or epic monsters. He can also restore Courage from hitting enemies with Pocket Pistol. Upon reaching 100 Courage, Skaarl instantly restores 40% – 70% (based on level) of her maximum health and reunites with Kled over 0.25 seconds, after which he consumes all Courage to become Mounted and the duo become unable to declare basic attacks or cast their abilities for 0.25 seconds. Mounting up resets the cooldowns of Bear Trap on a Rope and Jousting.

description4.plain: While at the allied fountain, 25 Courage is generated every 0.25 seconds. If reuniting outside of the fountain, Skaarl gets Frayed Nerves, which prevents Kled from gaining Courage for 30 seconds. Being within the fountain while Dismounted removes Frayed Nerves.

description5.plain: The current status of Kled's own health is preserved between subsequent dismounts.

blurb.plain: Innate: While Dismounted, Kled suffers all damage taken and is vulnerable to death. Kled's base health cannot be improved through any means, his movement speed is reduced, and his basic attacks against champions deal less physical damage. However, Kled gains a large amount of bonus movement speed when facing visible enemy champions, bonus armor and bonus magic resistance, and he has the ability to restore Skaarl Courage to mount again.

blurb2.plain: Courage: Kled gains a large amount of Courage by basic attacking champions and a small amount when killing minions, or attacking structures or epic monsters. At 100 Courage, Skaarl returns and Kled becomes Mounted. Kled's own health is preserved through re-mounting.

blurb3.plain: Entering the fountain will always restore Courage and return Skaarl. Outside of the fountain, Kled cannot gain Courage for 30 seconds after re-mounting.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Kled}} throws a bear trap in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and forms a {{tip|tether}} against the first {{tip|champion}} or {{tip|monster|large monster}} hit, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them.
params.blurb2: The tether shrinks over a brief time, after which '''Kled''' {{tip|airborne|pulls}} the target, dealing {{as|physical damage}}, and briefly {{tip|slow|slowing}} them.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kled''' throws a bear trap in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, increased to 150% against {{tip|minion|minions}}, small {{tip|pet|pets}}, and small and medium {{tip|monsters}}. The bear trap collides with the first enemy {{tip|champion}}, large pet, or large monster hit, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, and forming a {{tip|tether}} between '''Kled''' and the target for {{fd|1.75}} seconds.
params.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|30 to 130}} {{as|(+ 60% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Minion and Small Monster Damage|{{ap|30*1.5 to 130*1.5}} {{as|(+ 90% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
params.description2: The tether's radius shrinks over its duration, and if it is not broken before then, '''Kled''' {{tip|airborne|pulls}} the target {{tt|150|Estimated}} units toward him, deals {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} them for {{fd|2.5}} seconds.
params.leveling2:
{{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|30*2 to 130*2}} {{as|(+ 120% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|30*3 to 130*3}} {{as|(+ 180% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Slow|{{ap|30 to 50}}%}}
params.description3: ''Bear Trap on a Rope can be cast while {{ai|Jousting|Kled}}.''
params.range: {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 800|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|60|Center-to-edge radius check for enemies within the projectile's origin point, prioritizing the closest unit that can be affected by the tether.}}}}
params.notes:
{{Effect at cast time end}}
** The visual effect of ''Bear Trap on a Rope'' will appear at '''Kled's''' height at the end of cast time and may not portray its {{tip|projectile}} accurately if '''Kled''' is ''{{ai|Dismounted Skaarl the Cowardly Lizard|Kled|dismounting}}'' at the end of cast time.[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=B9uDhx4tS68&t=491s]
*** {{pending for test}} Is the same true if '''Kled''' is {{tip|airborne}}?
* The ability will cast to wherever the caster's cursor was at the start of the cast time.
* In addition to its {{tip|projectile}}, ''Bear Trap on a Rope'' will check for enemy champions, large monsters and large pets within a 60-unit center-to-edge radius area from the projectile's origin point.
** The projectile interacts with projectile-blocking effects but the area check doesn't.
* {{ui|link=Annie#Summon:_Tibbers|Tibbers}}, {{ai|Daisy!|Ivern|Daisy}} and {{ai|Eulogy of the Isles|Yorick|The Maiden}} are considered {{tip|pet|large pets}} for this ability.
** All other pets are considered small pets for the purposes of this ability.
* ''Bear Trap on a Rope'' will not {{tip|airborne|pull}} the target if they are in {{tip|stasis (buff)|stasis}}.
** {{pft}} certain sources of stasis are not affected 
* The tether cannot be broken within the first {{tt|{{fd|0.25}}|estimated}} seconds of its application.
* {{cai|Void Rush|Rek'Sai}} will break the tether upon the beginning of its cast time.{{bug}}
* The pull damage is updated dynamically based on '''Kled's''' current attack damage.
* {{csl|Kled|Count Kledula}} has no sound cue for when the tether is broken.{{bug}}
* The damage is also increased to 150% against {{ci|Neeko}} disguised as a {{tip|ward}}.
params.tips:
* When ''{{ai|Dismounted Skaarl the Cowardly Lizard|Kled|dismounting}}'' while attempting to cast ''Bear Trap on a Rope'', players should input movement commands to avoid unintentionally buffering {{ai|Pocket Pistol|Kled}}.

blurb.plain: Active: Kled throws a bear trap in the target direction that deals physical damage to enemies hit and forms a tether against the first champion or large monster hit, revealing them.

blurb2.plain: The tether shrinks over a brief time, after which Kled pulls the target, dealing physical damage, and briefly slowing them.

description.plain: Active: Kled throws a bear trap in the target direction that deals physical damage to enemies hit, increased to 150% against minions, small pets, and small and medium monsters. The bear trap collides with the first enemy champion, large pet, or large monster hit, revealing them for 2.5 seconds, and forming a tether between Kled and the target for 1.75 seconds.

description2.plain: The tether's radius shrinks over its duration, and if it is not broken before then, Kled pulls the target 150 units toward him, deals physical damage and slows them for 2.5 seconds.

description3.plain: Bear Trap on a Rope can be cast while Jousting.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Kled}} sprays a cone of ''pellets'' in the target direction that deal {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, during which he also {{tip|dash|recoils}} backward. Each ''pellet'' that hits an enemy {{tip|champion}} or epic {{tip|monster}} restores {{ai|Skaarl the Cowardly Lizard 3|Kled|{{as|Courage|buzzword}}}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kled''' sprays a cone of five ''pellets'' in the target direction while {{tip|dash|recoiling}} 300 units in the opposite direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit.
params.description2: '''Kled''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Pocket Pistol'' charge, up to a maximum of 2. He will restore both charges after ''{{ai|Dismounted Skaarl the Cowardly Lizard|Kled|dismounting}}''.
params.description3: Each ''pellet'' beyond the first to hit a target will only deal 20% damage. ''Pellets'' collide with the first enemy champion they hit. Each ''pellet'' that hits an enemy {{tip|champion}} or epic {{tip|monster}} restores ''{{ai|Skaarl the Cowardly Lizard 3|Kled|Courage}}'', by 5 and {{fd|2.5}} respectively, for up to a total restore of 25 against champions and {{fd|12.5}} versus epic monsters.
params.range: {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 700|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|55|Center-to-edge radius check for enemies within the projectiles' origin point.}}}}
params.angle: {{tt|20{{degree}}|Pellets are fired at -10{{degree}}, -5{{degree}}, 0{{degree}}, 5{{degree}} and 10{{degree}} from the cast direction}}
params.notes:
* The backwards {{tip|dash}} from ''Pocket Pistol'' can pass through terrain.
* ''Pocket Pistol'' can be cast while {{tip|ground|grounded}} or {{tip|root|rooted}} but '''Kled''' will not dash backwards.
{{Effect at cast time end}}
* The ability will cast to wherever the caster's cursor was at the start of the cast time.
* In addition to its {{tip|projectiles}}, ''Pocket Pistol'' will check for enemy champions within a 55-unit center-to-edge radius area from the projectiles' origin point.
** The projectiles interact with projectile-blocking effects but the area check doesn't.
* {{ii|Black Cleaver}} will specifically apply a stack for every pellet hit.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will negate multiple pellets if they hit at the same time.
** Even if the first pellet is negated, subsequent non-negated pellets will still only deal 20% of the damage.
* Pellets will restore {{as|Courage|buzzword}} when colliding with units protected by {{tip|spell shield}}, but will not restore {{as|Courage|buzzword}} when colliding with {{cai|Riposte|Fiora}}.
* {{pending for test}} ''Pocket Pistol'' will have no charges if '''Kled''' {{ai|Dismounted Skaarl the Cowardly Lizard|Kled|dismounts}} and triggers {{ri|Transcendence}} at the same time.{{bug}}
* {{pending for test}} ''Pocket Pistol'' will falsely visually appear to have another charge ready if the end of its cast time coincides with a charge being stocked.{{bug}}
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Kled''' is dashing:
{{ct|attack=false|move=false|cast=false|items=true,,,false|consume=true|spells=true,false,false,true,false,true,false|interrupts=death}}
'''Buffering Interactions'''
* Attempting to use any effect that would be buffered until the end of the cast time will instead delay it until the end of the dash, even if that effect is usable during the dash.
params.tips:
* Like other dashes with a cast time, the {{tip|dash|recoil}} can be used to override {{tip|airborne|forced displacement}} by beginning the cast shortly before the displacement takes effect.
* Like other dashes, ''Pocket Pistol's'' dash will end prematurely when colliding with terrain it can't pass, allowing '''Kled''' to act early.
* ''Pocket Pistol'' is not worth using for out-of-combat mobility if '''Kled''' has more than ~470 {{as|movement speed}}.

blurb.plain: Active: Kled & Skaarl become ghosted and unstoppably charge to a location, building up bonus movement speed and shield and leaving a draft in their wake that grants Mr. Kled's Wild Ride to allies that follow the draft.

description.plain: Active: Kled & Skaarl charge toward the target location, automatically navigating terrain along the way, during which they are ghosted, immune to crowd control and revealed to enemy champions in a 1250 radius. If the charge does not complete within 15 seconds, it will end prematurely. The charge is interrupted instantly if Kled dismounts during it.

description2.plain: While charging, the duo gain an initial shield, plus an additional amount for every 0.25 seconds of traveling, up to a cap at 2 seconds. The shield lasts for 2 seconds upon finishing the charge. Additionally, the duo trails a directional draft in their wake, lasting 9 seconds. Allied units other than lane minions following the draft gain Mr. Kled's Wild Ride. After 0.5 seconds of charging, the duo gain bonus movement speed every 0.25 seconds, up to 950 total movement speed over 3 seconds.

description3.plain: Mr. Kled's Wild Ride: While in champion combat, gain 40% bonus movement speed. After not being in champion combat for 3 seconds, if Kled is charging, gain bonus movement speed up to Kled's current movement speed; otherwise gain up to 650 total movement speed.

description4.plain: Kled & Skaarl will dash toward the first visible enemy champion in range of the charge, revealing the target during the dash and colliding with the first visible enemy champion in their path to deal magic damage, increased by 0% – 200% (based on charge time), knock them back 150 units, though not through terrain, and end the charge.
